title: Gate-Level Trojan Detection: Peripheral Controller Analysis
objective: Analyze a flat gate-level netlist of a peripheral controller block to identify any anomalous drivers of control nets, and report structural findings in a JSON report.

expected_outputs.description: A trojan_report.json under submission/ containing a verdict ('trojan_detected' or 'clean'), a list of suspect instance names drawn from controller_netlist.v, a rationale explaining the structural evidence, and (when applicable) the compromised net and its driving instance, plus optional orphaned/dangling logic instances.
expected_outputs.format: JSON object with fields: verdict (string), suspect_instances (array of strings), rationale (string), and conditionally compromised_net (string), driver_instance (string), and optionally orphaned_logic (array of strings).

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of hard security requirements (correct verdict, correct compromised net, correct driver instance) satisfied by the submitted report, measured as a binary/graded pass rate across the acceptance criteria.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of suspect_instances or orphaned_logic entries listed by the submission that do not correspond to any real anomaly-relevant instance, normalized by total instances listed.

metrics.name: inference_latency
metrics.description: Wall-clock time in seconds for the grading pipeline to parse the netlist, cross-check the submitted report, and produce a verdict.

metrics.name: structural_grounding_score
metrics.description: Fraction of functional requirements satisfied (valid JSON schema, real instance-name references, required conditional fields present), independent of whether the security conclusion is correct.

notes: Participants must not modify any file under inputs/. Only submission/trojan_report.json is graded.
